purpose: Pre-specify latent partial-noising, deterministic DDIM reconstruction, and deviation-map definition before scientific diffusion training and before observing validation reconstruction performance.
artifact_type: methodological design, not an experiment result

inference_source.production_preprocessing: Use existing production preprocessing unchanged; no pathology corruption.

semantics: beta is derived from consecutive normalized cosine alpha-bar points, then clamped to max_beta
forward_schedule.schedule_source: Use the existing implementation for both training and inference; this contract does not define a second schedule implementation.

partial_noise.reason: nearest locked cosine-schedule timestep to alpha_bar = 0.50

ddim.sequence_semantics: Inclusive endpoints; round to nearest integer. The resolved integer sequence below is authoritative.
ddim.epsilon_prediction: epsilon_hat = model(z_current, t) using the declared inference weights
ddim.reverse_transition_condition: t_prev >= 0; t_prev is the next entry in resolved_timesteps, not necessarily t-1
ddim.terminal_model_evaluation: At t=0: Zprior = z0_hat, followed by the required support masking; do not take a further scheduled transition.
ddim.evaluation_count_semantics: 50 model evaluations: 49 scheduled transitions followed by the terminal z0_hat at t=0.

sensitivity_ddim_semantics: Resolved integer sequences are authoritative. Use the primary DDIM reverse equations, terminal evaluation, and support masking with each sensitivity sequence. Sensitivity outputs remain secondary and cannot redefine the primary timestep or sequence.

support.source: Raw MRI patch before normalization, never normalized MRI or GT segmentation.
support.after_every_reverse_latent: z_prev = z_prev * support_mask before the next network evaluation

randomness.sample_identity_encoding: Ordered JSON array [case_id, crop_start_d, crop_start_h, crop_start_w, crop_stop_d, crop_stop_h, crop_stop_w]; case_id is an exact string, coordinates are integers from the manifest.
randomness.paired_noise_identity: For a fixed sample identity and replicate index, use the same epsilon realization at t=327, t=495, and t=663.
randomness.paired_noise_reason: paired sensitivity comparison isolates partial-noise strength while holding the underlying Gaussian noise realization fixed
randomness.seed_timestep_exclusion: Diffusion timestep is NOT part of the partial-noise seed payload.
randomness.seed_serialization: UTF-8 encoding of compact JSON with separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=false, no whitespace or trailing newline; seed and replicate index are integers.
randomness.noise_generation: For each sample and replicate, seed a separate CPU torch.Generator and draw torch.randn((256,12,12,12), dtype=torch.float32, device='cpu', generator=generator), then transfer to the execution device and apply support masking. Do not draw from a batch-wide or device-specific generator.

primary_deviation.name: DeltaZ
primary_deviation.latent_space: fixed D0-A standardized anatomy latent space
primary_deviation.outside_support_interpretation: Zeros outside support represent invalid/masked locations and must not enter scientific summary statistics as real zero-deviation observations.

outputs: full per-channel absolute difference tensor when storage permits
sensitivity maps at t=327 and t=663

inference_weights.checkpoint_source: checkpoint selected by the already-locked validation criterion
inference_weights.checkpoint_selection_criterion: lowest mean case-level validation support-masked epsilon MSE

design_lock.distinction: Future checkpoint selection uses the pre-declared validation epsilon-MSE rule. Inference t*, eta, DDIM steps, K, and DeltaZ aggregation are frozen before scientific training and are not selected from validation reconstruction performance.
